broken_or_missing_handlers.detail: Two <script> blocks define submitShowRunner / submitComedian / submitBooker / submitMessage / showPath. Second declaration wins (function hoisting). Block 1 (LeadCapture flow, with localStorage + mailto fallback) is DEAD CODE. Production runs Block 2 (postForm) which has no offline fallback and uses a different endpoint (/api/book vs /api/show-submission etc.).
Listens on 127.0.0.1:8787 only. No public form actually POSTs to /api/intake — all book.html forms target api-config.json's `api` host. Code path is orphaned.
Review queue page is fully static (no JS, no fetch). data/review_queue.json is `[]` with no producer. Submission flow does not deposit anything here. Schema for review_queue.json is undefined.
Only #message has the website honeypot. show-runner, comedian, booker tabs are unprotected against bots.
JSONL_PATH.write_text(JSONL_PATH.read_text() + ...) — read-modify-write with no lock. Concurrent submissions can drop rows. ThreadingHTTPServer makes this very real.
showPath() and DOMContentLoaded handler are defined twice in the same file. Same hash-routing handler attached twice.
TODO comment: 'add password gate before sharing URL'. Page is reachable directly. Anyone who knows the URL can POST to /api/book with _type=admin_show_submit.
time defaults to '20:00' if empty — quietly fabricates a start time that the user didn't enter.
slice(0,60) silently truncates id — long show names collide.

'Copy → paste into data/shows_upcoming.json' — that file is part of the static intake, but pipeline since P4.PAGES.1 reads data/freshness-audit.json + adapters. Manual paste workflow is undocumented after recent refactors.
Badge count '0' and 'Last updated 2026-05-19' are hard-coded HTML — never updated.
Validates kind in {newsletter, contact, listing}. book.html does not send `kind` matching this set — incompatible with intake_server even if it were exposed.

summary.primary_finding: book.html ships two competing submission code paths. The second (postForm → /api/book) wins. The first (LeadCapture, with offline fallback) is dead code. Review queue is a static stub; no submission ever lands in data/review_queue.json.
submission_destinations_in_practice: /api/book on api-config.json host (live but backend not in this repo)
/api/show/claim on api-config.json host (live but backend not in this repo)
